d:
Chennai ki Monty Colony ka ek ghar, jahan se raat hote hi aurat ke cheekhne, bachon ke bhaagne aur ek mard ki awaaz sunai deti hai. Raat ke 11 baje, rishton se haar kar lauti Bharatanatyam dancer Meera is ghar ke andar kadam rakhti hai. Lekin is ghar mein aisa kya hai jo har baar kisi ka intezaar karta hai? Aur Meera ke saath andar jaane ke baad kya hua?
Dekhiye Sannata
